Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Sri Lankan players are out in the middle. Lendl Simmons and  Evin Lewis are the openers for West Indies. Skipper Angelo Mathews will start with the ball. Here we go...

Right! Not a big score for the West Indies to chase! And the kind of fire they have in their batting unit, it shouldn't worry them much. A couple of early wickets will give Sri Lanka some chance. Join us for the chase which begins shortly.

Kevin Sinclair is caught for a quick chat. He says that he was confident in the middle. Tells there was no pressure on him. Wanted to be normal and play the game. Says that the first wicket was special for him. On playing with Gayle, Sinclair says that being in the same dressing room as Gayle is a big moment in his career.

The Men in Maroon will be mighty pleased with their bowling performance. Skipper Pollard won the toss and opted to bowl. They kept things tight in the Powerplay and then all the bowlers combined to put on a fantastic performance. Sinclair started superbly and got his maiden wicket. Edwards, making his return to the national time was superb as well. Holder bowled a superb 4-over spell, giving away just 19 off his 4 and got one. Obed McCoy got two in his 4 overs and he was the pick of the bowler. Bravo and Allen too managed a wicket. Overall, a fine bowling performance from the Windies bowlers.

Sri Lanka started decently by adding 40 in the Powerplay and lost just one wicket. Dickwella along with debutant Nissanka added 50-plus and the visitors were looking set for a big score. However, once Dickwella fell, things derailed for the Lankans. They just kept losing wickets and failed to give the final impetus to the innings. The batters will be disappointed with their efforts.

End of a terrific bowling performance from the hosts. They have stopped Sri Lanka to an under par score here. The hosts won the toss and their bowlers have done the job as asked by skipper Pollard. All the bowlers who bowled kept things tight and never allowed the visitors to go big.

OUT! RUN OUT! A wicket to end the innings. Very full ball around middle, Chameera hits it down the ground. They want the second but it is never on. The fielder from long on throws a bullet throw to the keeper and Pooran whips the bails off in a flash. Sri Lanka end with 131/9.
Third umpire has been called again. It is once again to check a run out call.
Full ball around middle, Dananjaya flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there, Lewis, fails to pick the ball and allows extra runs. Three taken.
A fuller ball outside off, flicked to deep square leg for just one.
Dushmantha Chameera is the new man in.
Run out appeal taken upstairs.

OUT! RUN OUT! The bat is in the air. Number 8 falls for Sri Lanka. A fuller ball on middle, Bandara flicks it down to deep mid-wicket. They go for the second run. The fielder in the deep, Allen, gives the throw to the keeper and Pooran takes the bails off. The third umpire has been called for. Replays roll in. They show that his bat is in the air. Bandara's dive won't save him.
Low full toss, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Play and a miss! Lovely slower one from Bravo. Dananhaya is way too early in his slog. The ball goes past the leg pole.
Back of a length ball outside off, guided down to third man for one. 7 off the penultimate over. 4-0-29-1 from Edwards on his return.
Fuller and around off, pushed on the off side for one.

Just two. So, a superb effort and McCoy saves two for his side. A back of a length ball outside off, Bandara looks to cut it over the off side but ends up getting it off the outside edge. The ball races to the third man fence. McCoy runs to his left and then puts in a big dive to push the ball back in play. Two taken.
Is that a boundary? That was an excellent effort near the ropes from McCoy. But maybe not good enough. The third umpire is having a look.
Pokes this one towards the off side and crosses for a run.
Play and a miss! Short ball just around off, Dananjaya looks to leave it alone but at the last moment looks to guide it over the short third man region but fails to connect.

Misfield and two! A shortish length ball around off, Akila pokes it in front of Gayle who is at covers. They go for the single. Gayle charges towards the ball but fails to pick it up. Ends up giving one extra.
Who will bowl the penultimate over of the innings? Fiden Edwards it is.
FOUR! Drilled! Welcome boundary for Sri Lanka. A fuller ball around off, Bandara slams it down the ground and beats Pollard to his right to find the fence. Good end to the over.
Fuller and around middle, flicked on the leg side for one.
Bouncer to the man. It is on middle. Akila ducks.
Fuller ball outside off, driven down to deep cover for a single.
Whose in next? Akila Dananjaya it is.

OUT! CAUGHT IN THE DEEP! A Stunner from Allen. A slower one, outside off, Hasaranga goes for the slog. He connects it well and hits it wide of Allen who is at deep mid-wicket. He runs to his left and then puts in a dive to gobble the chance. Excellent grab from him. The visitors slip further.
Fuller and around middle, driven down to long on for two.
Single to end the spell. Good length and outside off, Hasaranga pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single. End off a terrific spell.
Lovely slower one again. Hasaranga waited, waited and waited. He eventually tried to cut still ended up missing out because of the slowness. Smart and brilliant from McCoy.
One more single as Bandara guides it wide of Holder at short third man.
Back of a length ball around off, pushed towards short third man and they go for a single. Holder picks the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but fails to hit the target.
Debutant Ashen Bandara is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Perera falls now. It is a huge wicket because he can take the game away from the opposition in a flash. A lovely slower one from McCoy. Perera is a bit too early in his slog as he failed to read the slower one. He tried to bail himself out but that was a bit too late. He ends up miscuing it high in the air towards long on. Bravo comes ahead and takes the catch easily.
Shortish and around off, tapped towards short third man for a quick run.
Crunched but finds Gayle. A slower length ball outside off, Perera waits and then hits it hard but finds Gayle at covers. Just 5 off the 16th over.
Good length and around middle, pushed down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, hit wide of the man at deep square leg for a brace.
Lovely yorker! Hasaranga does well to block it out. It goes behind to the keeper and they take a risky single.
Length ball outside off, Hasaranga looks to push it on the off side but ends up getting an inside edge. The ball goes to the left of the keeper. Pooran does well to stop.
Length ball outside off, punched wide of deep cover for a brace by Hasaranga.
Dwayne Bravo is back for his 2nd over.
Single on the last ball of the over and it brings up 100 for the visitors. A length ball around off, it is tapped on the off side for a quick run.
Low full toss outside off, Hasaranga finds Gayle at covers.
Shorith and around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Banged short and on middle, Thisara sits under it.

Just wide! Lovely slower one from Obed. He runs in and bowls a slower fuller ball. Hasaranga looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes behind. It is wide of Pooran who cannot get to the ball. A single taken.
Wanindu Hasaranga is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! McCoy strikes now. Half the side back in the hut. Lovely short ball just around off. Chandimal stays back and looks to guide it down to the third man region. He though ends up hitting it straight to Holder at short third man. Holder with his bucket hands is not going to drop it.
WIDE! Slower one goes down the leg side. Dinesh lets it be. Wided by the umpire.
Here's Thisara Perera. Obed McCoy is back with the ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Sharp catch at short fine leg. A length ball on the pads, Mathews, the skipper, tries to use the pace of the ball and flick it over short fine leg. He makes a good connection but hits it straight to Simmons who shows good reaction to gobble the chance.
Short ball outside off, pulled wide of the man at deep mid-wicket for two. The throw from Pollard was a poor one.
Good length ball around off, pushed to long on for a run.
Excellent comeback from Edwards. Bowls this one just outside off on a good length. Chandimal looks to cut but misses.
SIX! BANG! Right off the middle. A fuller ball, just around off, right in the slot. Chandimal launches it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Classy from Chandimal.
Short ball outside off, Mathews pulls it off the inner half to deep backward square leg. A Single.

We are back again. The two umpires stride out to the middle. The Windies players are in a huddle near the rope. They now spread out in the ground to take their positions. Chandimal and Mathews will resume with the bat for the Lankans. Fidel Edwards with the ball.
UPDATE 1912 local (2312 GMT) - The rain seems to have stopped. The resumption is not too far away.
UPDATE 1705 local (2305 GMT) - The rain has got a bit heavier here. Let's hope things get better quickly. For now, the covers are firmly placed on the wicket.
Well, well. It has started to rain, out of nowhere. The umpires take the players off. And the covers are coming on now. Looks like just a passing shower.
Single to end the over. Just 3 runs and the wicket of set batter in it. Full and around off, pushed towards mid off for a quick run.
Tossed up and outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
Flat and just outside off, pushed through the off side for a run.
Short ball outside off, punched to long off for a single.
Skipper Angelo Mathews is in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Allen strikes in his first over. Lovely stuff from him. He tosses it up and bowls it slower. Nissanka comes down the track and looks to go big on the leg side. He misses as the ball turns just a hint to beat his bat. Pooran behind the wickets takes the bails off in a flash. Decent knock from Nissanka on debut.

Confusion but safe! Tossed up and around off and middle, Chandimal comes down the track and hits it to the left of the man at long off. They take the first one quickly. Nissanka wants the second but Chandimal is not keen. Luckily the throw is at the bowler's end from the deep who fails to collect.
Fabian Allen is on now.
Sngle to end the over! A short ball outside off, cut to deep point for one. Holder ends the evening with the ball. 4-0-19-1. Fine performance.
Another slower one from Holder. Nissanka goes for the pull after waiting. Hits it to long on for one.
Slower bouncer. Chandimal goes for the pull but he is way too early. Misses and gets hit on the body. They cross for a leg bye as the ball goes to the off side.
Short and wide outside off, the slower one from Jason. Chandimal cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full and wide outside off, squeezed wide of the gully fielder for one.
Back of a length and just outside off, Chandimal guides it to third man for one.

Two to end the over. Shortish ball outside off, crunched wide of the man at deep cover. Allen does well there to stop with a slide. Hits ths stumps at the striker's end from the deep but Nissanka was safe.
Good length and around off, pushed towards the bowler.
FOUR! Here's the much-needed boundary. Fuller and wider outside off, Nissanka squeezes it through backward point and finds the fence.
Play and a miss again! Three dots in a row. Outside off on a fuller length. Nissanka looks to drive away from his body but fails to make any connection.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to the man at covers.
Lovely slower one to begin from Bravo. It is full and wide outside off, Nissanka looks to drive but misses.
Dinesh Chandimal joins Pathum Nissanka in the middle now. Here's Dwayne Bravo with the ball.

OUT! TIMBER! Well, well. He can end the over with a wicket. He deserved that wicket. A Full toss around off, Dickwella gets down and looks to sweep but he is a bit too early. Misses and the furniture behind gets disturbed. Decent knock from Dickwella but Sri Lanka needed him to continue.
Full and on middle and leg, Nissanka looks to flick but gets it off the inner half to deep square leg. A single. Just 1 off the over. Can Holder end it well?
Another dot. This is superb stuff from Holder. A slower short ball from him. Nissanka waits and waits and then tries to pull but misses.
Dickwella has a word with the debutant.
Three dots in a row! A superb yorker length ball outside off. Nissanka cannot put bat on ball.
Full and wide outside off, Nissanka looks to reach out and carve it on the off side but fails.
Change of pace from Holder this time and he beats the batsman.
Here's Jason Holder again.

Good slower one to end the over. Dickwella wanted to play the scoop over the leg side but Obed bowled it wide outside off. Dickwella tries to play the reverse scoopy by adjusting at the last moment but he failed to connect.
SIX! Nice pick up shot and it goes all the way. A length ball just around off, Dickwells picks it up and hits it over deep square leg for a maximum. 50-run stand is up between the two.
Fuller ball on middle, Nissanka hits it towards long on for a run.
WIDE! Tries for the slower one again but this time he slips it down the leg side. Nissanka looks to flick but misses. Given wide by the umpire.
Good change of pace from McCoy this time. Bowls a slower one outside off on a fuller length. Pathum looks to drive but misses.
Just short. Short ball outside off, Dickwella hits it uppishly down to deep point. The fielder in the deep doesn't attack the ball and allows to boucne it in front.
Full ball outside off, hit to mid off for a quick run.
Fired outside off, clipped to long on for one. 13 off the over, a big one for the visitors.
Dickwella dances down the track and Sinclair smartly drags the length short. It is pushed down to long on for one.
Flat and around middle, worked on the leg side for an easy single.
SIX! BANG! This one has gone off the sweep spot. Once again Sinclair tosses it up and bowls it around middle, Nissanka nails the slog over the deep mid-wicket fence. First biggie of the game.
FOUR! Superb shot! Floated on middle, Nissanka flicks it uppishly and hits it wide of the man at deep mid-wicket. Finds the fence and it brings up 50 for the visitors.
Darted on the pad, Nissanka looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.
Kevin Sinclair is back again. 2-0-13-1 from him so far.
Play and a miss! Good finish to the over. Outside off on a length, Dickwell slashes at it but misses.
Dot now! Full and wide again, Dickwella mistimes it to the man at covers.
Too full this time and outside off. It is squeezed on the off side for a single.
FOUR! BOOM! In the slot and Nissanka plays a superb drive! A fullish ball, right under the bat. Nissanka nails the drive wide of the man at mid off. It races away to the fence.
Low full toss on middle, clipped to deep square leg for a run.
A full ball outside off to begin from McCoy. Nissanka strokes it to deep cover for one.
Obed McCoy is into the attack now.
Single to end the Powerplay! A full ball just outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick run. 40 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Nissanka looks to pull but only manages to connect with thin air.
FOUR! Another boundary in the over. A fullish ball on the pads, Nissanka flicks it wide of the man at fine leg. Allen from that position gives it a chase, puts in a dive forward to stop but fails.
Short and wide outside off, slashed to the left of the man at deep point. The fielder there is quick to get around and keep the batters to just one.
FOUR! Crunched this time. A low full toss just outside off, Dickwell drives it through the covers and finds the fence.
Play and a miss! Fullish ball outside off, Dickwell looks to drive away from his body but fails to connect.
Who will bowl the last over of the Powerplay? Jason Holder will continue.
Single to end the 5th over. A short ball on middle, pulled down to deep square leg for an easy single.
Missed out again! A fuller ball down the leg side. Nissanka looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. A leg bye taken as the ball goes to short fine leg.

Two more! Not off the middle of the bat though. It was a short ball on middle, Nissanka wanted to hammer it via pull but he failed to time it as well as he would've wanted. Clears square leg and scampers back for two.
Slips this one full but down the leg side. Nissanka flicks it to fine leg where debutant Sinclair misfields and allows one extra run. Two more for Nissanka.
Pace and zip for Edwards. Bangs it short and outside off, Nissanka slashes at it but fails to make any connection.
Fuller and outside off, driven to the cover region for nothing.
Fidel Edwards is back for his 2nd over.
Nissanka is up and running on the first ball. Shortish and on the pads, tucked down to fine leg for one. Just 4 off the 4th over.
Short and wide, cut to deep point for one.
Another dot. Three in a row. A full ball outside off, Dickwell tries the cheeky scoop over the leg side but Holder smartly bowls it wide outside off. Dickwella fails to put bat on ball again.
Beaten again! Lovely from Holder here. Another length ball outside off, Dickwell flirts with it but luckily fails to connect.
Pace and bounce from Holder. He lands this one on a good length and angles it away. Dickwella pokes at it but makes no connection.
Good stop near the fence. A short ball outside off to begin, it is hit through backward point. The man in the deep runs to his right and make a sliding stop to save two.
Pathum Nissanka, the one of the two Sri Lankan debutants, strides out in the middle. Also, here's Jason Holder with the ball.

OUT! TAKEN BY THE SKIPPER! Sinclair gets his maiden T20I wicket and he goes for his acrobatic celebration. Tossed up and on middle again, this time Gunathilaka goes for the slog but he fails to middle it well. It goes wide of Pollard who is manning the mid-wicket region. He flies to his right and takes a fine catch. Good start for the hosts here.
Floated on middle, flicked on the leg side for nothing.
Flat and around off, pushed to mid off for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept nicely. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Dickwella gets down and goes for the sweep. Connects it and hits it over the man at short fine leg.
Short and wide outside off, Dickwella cuts but cannot find the gap at bacward point.

In the air... safe! A tossed up ball on middle, Dickwella jumps out of the crease and looks to go big over the bowler's head. Fails to time it well but clears the men in the ring. Two taken before mid off can get to the ball.

A bit of yes-no but they get the single. Low full toss on middle and leg, Dickwella clips it towards mid on and calls for the single. Gunathilaka is a bit slow in taking off but they make it easily in the end.
Another dot! Good comeback since that boundary delivery from Edwards. A fullish ball around off, poked towards the cover region. Can Edwards end the over well?
Fuller and outside off, pushed towards backward point for nothing.
Around off on a length, pushed towards mid off.

FOUR! First boundary of the game. Bit wayward from Edwards so far. A full toss outside off. Dickwella strokes it nicely and manages to beat the fielder in the ring on the off side. Races away to the deep point fence.
Quick single! A length ball around middle and leg, Gunathilaka pokes it to mid on and takes a quick run.
WIDE! Edwards begins with a ball down the leg side. Gunathilaka looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Will it be pace from the other end? Yes, it is. Fidel Edwards will bowl now. His last international game was way back in 2012, against the same opposition.
Loopy ball outside off, hit down to long off for one. 6 off the opening over. Solid start for Sri Lanka. Decent first over from the debutant.
Floated on the pads, tucked towards backward square leg for a run.
Tossed up and just outside off, driven to long off for one. 4 singles in the over so far.
Flat and around off, Dickwell punches it towards the cover region and rotates strike.
Gunathilaka is off the mark on the first ball as well. This one is full and wide outside off. Gunathilaka drives it to deep cover for a single.
Dickwella and Sri Lanka are underway! A shortish ball outside off, Dickwell hits it wide of the man at backward point and takes a single

Right! We are done and dusted with all the pre-game formalities. It is time for the action. The West Indies players take their positions in the field. Danushka Gunathilaka will open the batting along with Niroshan Dickwella. Debutant Kevin Sinclair will begin with the ball for West Indies. The players take the knee in support of the BLM movement. And we are ready to roll. Here we go...
Before the action begins, it is time for the National Anthems of both the teams.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI): Danushka Gunathilaka, Niroshan Dickwella (WK), Pathum Nissanka (DEBUT), Dinesh Chandimal, Angelo Mathews (C), Ashen Bandara (DEBUT), Thisara Perera, Wanindu Hasaranga, Akila Dananjaya, Dushmantha Chameera, Nuwan Pradeep.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews, starts by saying that they have an inexperienced team but the players have a chance to prove themselves. Hopes to give a good fight. Tells it was unfortunate that Dasun failed to get the visa. Informs that Dasun, the regular skipper, will be back in the team after three T20Is.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Lendl Simmons, Evin Lewis, Chris Gayle, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder, Fabian Allen, Dwayne Bravo, Kevin Sinclair (DEBUT), Obed McCoy, Fidel Edwards.

Kieron Pollard, the West Indies skipper, says that they have the old boys playing for them and he is happy to have them in the side. Tells that they add a wealth of experience to the side. Informs that Kevin Sinclair is making his debut for the West Indies.
Toss - It is time for the spin of the coin. Up it goes and it lands in the favor of Kieron Pollard. West Indies will BOWL FIRST.

How will the first game pan out? West Indies have the Universe Boss returning to the team. For Sri Lanka, well, their skipper failed to join the team due to some visa issues. So, the hosts have big names under their wings while Sri Lanka have inexperienced men. However, do not forget that in the shortest version of the game, it is the performance on the day that counts. So, will we see the inexperienced bunch trump the proven T20 stars in their own den? How will the wicket behave in this first game? How crucial will be the toss? Plenty of questions and they will all be answered shortly. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

Hello, world! International cricket resumes in West Indies for the first time since the Covid-19 pandemic began last year. The Men in Maroon are ready to host Sri Lanka for a long tour. It begins with 3 T20Is and in the year where the T20 World Cup is not too far away, every chance of playing the shortest format presents a big opportunity for the teams up get things in order before the mega event.
